title: Dear Google, Apple, Mozilla, and MS: Please End Auto-Playing Media in Browsers
author: geuis
excerpt: I know there are plugins than can somewhat do this, but no solutions are universal or great. Please update all of our browsers so that no automatic video/audio can play without user interaction/permission. Its getting to be impossible to visit many sites today without being bombarded by video and sound playing by default on the web. In the worst cases such as on mobile browsers like iOS Safari, visiting a site will start playing media that kills whatever you're already listen

title: Ask HN: Who is firing?
author: wellworld
excerpt: The startup I work at will soon be undergoing an exodus of staff due to a failure in leadership and management by the founders. Really painful, sad, situation for all involved. So, I figure if we're allowed to talk about who is hiring, why not the other way around? At the very least, we can get a pulse on those companies which smells like roses on the outside, and reek of something more earthy on the inside.
